events.headline: US 285 southbound: Road closed, due to roadwork.

Between Albion Street and Downing Street (Cherry Hills Village) from Mile Point 262.69 to Mile Point 260.92. Road closed due to roadwork. Starting tomorrow at 7:30AM MST until tomorrow at about 3:30PM MST.

Comment: This is a full closure of EB Hampden from Downing Street to Colorado Blvd to accommodate the funeral procession for the fallen Lakewood Police officer.

events.headline: CO 52 in both directions: Road closed, due to road construction.
events.description:
Between Hudson Drive and Holly Street (Hudson) from Mile Point 29.52 to Mile Point 30.05. Road closed expect delays due to road construction. Until Saturday, at about 11:59PM MST.

Full schedule below:
    • November 8, 12:00AM - November 14, 11:59PM

Comment: Full closure of Main Street (CO 52) between I-76 Frontage Road and Holly Street in Hudson through the 3rd week of November for revitalization work. Detour using I-76 Frontage Road and County Road 51. Local access to town via County Road 47, County Road 10, and County Road 45 (Beech Street).
